name: @scout-ui/sticker-trail
description: A standalone, bounded sticker trail interaction for React.

scripts.build: rollup --config rollup.config.mjs && tsc --project tsconfig.json --emitDeclarationOnly --composite false --incremental false --pretty false && node ../../tooling/rollup/embed-declaration-sources.mjs dist && node ../../tooling/rollup/copy-static.mjs src/styles.css dist/styles.css
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project tsconfig.json --noEmit --pretty false && tsc --project tsconfig.type-tests.json --pretty false
